selection_source: DD01/12 comparisons fixed after 328 review and exploratory history/model inspection, before formal exact audit; not blind, prospective or preregistered
ideal_model_scope: Six distinct numbers sampled uniformly without replacement from 49; current target mapping assumed; independent of past. Exact counts only within this hypothetical mechanism, NOT actual success, forecast, price or return.
display_definition: Each explicitly named sign must appear among the normal six to complete a column. Seventh and reserve do not count.

repeat_caveat: Because the six normal 328 identities and the seven-ball 328 identities are different sets, repeat counts 6-to-6 and 7-to-7 use separate cohorts. Full DD01 columns require repeat 3 or 4 among normal six, which is necessary not sufficient.
structural_impossibility: With A/B across two routes and A/C/D across all three, B necessarily shares a route with either C or D; presence of a route is not identity.
